ideas.pitch: A multi-agent workflow system that coordinates calendar scheduling, email triage, and automated document generation across multiple small-business tools.

ideas.title: AgentSync Multi-Agent Personal Executive Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Everyday Automation track by showcasing a functional multi-agent loop with a clear central workflow completed within 30 hours, appealing heavily to judges looking for practical utility.

ideas.title: MediDispatch Rural Triage AI Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the Agentic AI track with a compelling social impact angle, combining speech-to-text integration with an autonomous reasoning engine for triage.
